objective: Stress-test the no-boundary-contact Dovekie-only IVS profile on a wider finite search box and denser grid.

domain.role: Numerical sensitivity domain only, not a prior.

interpretation: The wider-box, denser-grid minimum is numerically indistinguishable from the base-box solution and touches no new boundary. This reuses the production scorer; it is not independent verification, a proof of global optimality, or physical viability beyond the observed SN redshift range.
command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 1200 -- .venv/bin/python experiments/dovekie_ivs_profile/domain_sensitivity.py
